author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Schwarber (back) hopeful to return to lineup Thursday
desc: Kyle Schwarber is hopeful to be back in the Phillies lineup on Thursday.
impact: Schwarber is sitting a second straight game on Wednesday. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Tucker (back) remains out of lineup Wednesday
desc: Kyle Tucker remains out of the Dodgers lineup on Wednesday against the Twins.
impact: Tucker remains hopeful to be back for Friday's series opener against the Padres.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dalton Rushing (concussion) back in lineup Wednesday
desc: Dalton Rushing is back in the Dodgers lineup on Wednesday against the Twins.
impact: Rushing returns from a one-game absence. He is back behind the plate and batting eighth.

author: Nate Miller
title: Logan VanWey sent down to minors
desc: Logan VanWey was optioned to Triple-A ahead of Wednesday's game against the Blue Jays.
impact: VanWey was recalled earlier this week, but  after pitching three innings over the past two nights, the Astros will look to get a fresher arm up in their bullpen. Colton Gordon waa called up in a corresponding move.

author: Nate Miller
title: Colton Gordon called up Wednesday
desc: Colton Gordon was recalled from Triple-A ahead of Wednesday's game against the Blue Jays.
impact: Gordon made four appearances for the Astros back in April, including one start. The lefty posted an ugly 11.57 ERA over 9 1/3 innings, but he's been much better at Triple-A. Logan VanWey was optioned in a corresponding move.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brice Turang swipes base in win over Reds
desc: Brice Turang went 2-for-4 in a win over the Reds with one run scored and one stolen base.
impact: Turang has heated back up, getting on base in seven of his last eight contests. The second baseman continues to offer manager Pat Murphy one of the more dynamic options in the Brewers lineup, carrying an .831 OPS with 11 home runs, 57 runs scored, 47 RBI, and 13 stolen bases across 73 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Addison Barger (elbow) to be re-evaluated before rehab assignment
desc: Addison Barger is flying to Toronto to be re-evaluated before starting a rehab assignment.
impact: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Barger is still dealing with soreness when swinging. There should be an update on his status later in the week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Masyn Winn (thumb) not in lineup Wednesday
desc: Masyn Winn is not in the Cardinals lineup on Wednesday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: Winn is still waiting on the results of the MRI he underwent.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cristian Javier (shoulder) could be activated this weekend
desc: The Astros could activate Cristian Javier from the injured list this weekend.
impact: Javier made his last rehab start last Sunday. He could be activated to return on Saturday or Sunday.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Cooper Pratt swipes base in win over Reds
desc: Cooper Pratt went 0-for-3 in a win over the Reds with a walk and one stolen base.
impact: Pratt continues a steady stretch, reaching base in six of his last seven contests. The infielder has been impactful since being called up, batting .304 with four stolen bases, two RBI, and two runs scored across eight games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ben Brown (neck) sent back to Chicago to be re-evaluated
desc: Ben Brown was sent back to Chicago to see specialists about his neck issue.
impact: Brown landed on the injured list on Wednesday. There will be an update on a potential timeline when available.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jeremy Pena (hamstring) back in lineup Wednesday
desc: Jeremy Pena is back in the Astros lineup on Wednesday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Pena returns from a one-game absence. He is back in the lineup for Wednesday's series finale.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Caleb Durbin suffers finger subluxation
desc: The Red Sox say Caleb Durbin suffered a left fifth finger subluxation.
impact: Durbin partially dislocated his pinky. He will continue to be further evaluated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jack Flaherty (leg) expected to return Saturday
desc: Jack Flaherty is on track to be activated to start on Saturday against the Astros.
impact: Flaherty threw 83 pitches over 5 2/3 innings in his lone rehab start. The Tigers could end up running out a six-man rotation.

author: Ari Koslow
title: CJ Abrams (side) could return Wednesday
desc: Nationals manager Blake Butera said CJ Abrams is feeling better on Wednesday.
impact: Abrams is going through a workout and then they'll decide if he's able to play.
